digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, reconciler lifecycle, cli registry, configuration stack, code-review kernel
propositions: RP-02 must recover multi-file binding atomicity with ordered exact-match retirement: durable tombstone, live forward/reverse pair recovery only when identities match exactly, repeat is no-op, ambiguity aborts

RP-03 must own Jira lifecycle orchestration with bounded retry (3 physical calls, 15s sleep, 2s/4s fallback), exhausted-logic-based finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive across 2+ tickets), and commit_unknown for lost create responses

RP-04 must compose a per-operation snapshot with explicit > environment > project > user > default precedence, separate secret boundary, fail-closed malformed config, and removal of adapter-local DIG fallback

RP-05 must establish a lazy immutable CLI registry with canonical package-data help for all 54 public commands, exact-alias reuse, compatibility-shim specific help, pre-operation routing before config/handler/optional imports

RP-06 must enforce effective-policy applicability routing (disabled built-ins skip, project criteria match applies_to globs, DET selected), typed discovery trace with Option-B failure isolation, explicit --retry for INDETERMINATE lineage with fresh budgets, and positive usd_budget enforcement
